transcript_segments_requiring_review.reason: Incident alone missed makes the news and strange conclusion; add those explanatory targets before calling the whole paragraph covered.
Long false-start sentence crosses into 57; protests broke out and demanding justice remain barriers beyond introductory phrase matches.
Atrium and university president corrected, but nevertheless is a contrast marker worth teaching; a single matched noun never establishes complete coverage.
Footage and that's been released are not explained by the matched negative impression pattern alone.
Back out of the parking spot and so that purpose/result deserve explanation; clear alone is insufficient.
Brutally punished versus peacefully protesting and gonna be emotions involved need vocabulary/register support; do not erase the contrast.
Long attributed statement includes ongoing verbal and online abuse and are known to; several word hits do not resolve those barriers.
As well as continues 75; wording resulting in the case of two individual bans is awkward and must not be silently reconstructed from assumed audio.
Automatic braking system is a technical phrase needing a card; do not endorse the claimed car behavior or infer automatic driving capabilities.
Motive of silencing speech is an additional collocation/metaphor not covered by the two nouns.
No place in means unacceptable in a community. Opening It is no place is suspect transcript wording; retain and flag instead of repairing a quote.
Senior here means final-year university student, not an elderly person; deserves a contextual card.
Continues work for Cornell; by default carries an inference about institutional responsibility and needs explanation. Deemed alone is insufficient.
File a civil lawsuit and dubbed the Cornell Seven introduce process and naming; Jane Doe is a pseudonym, not a translation of an ordinary name. Need explicit civil/dubbed support.
Gang essayed is euphemistic/ASR wording in this PDF; do not present it as standard English or silently replace it. Dropping out and ripped apart remain useful barriers; all claims are attributed.
Workshop and reflection papers need educational-context definitions; repeated essays is self-repair, not several separate punishments.
Mainstream media and going against need language support. Final Trump is a conversational handoff continued in 105, not part of a repaired quote.
Commenting and fair treatment covered, but prosecutor remains a role-specific gap; do not mark complete just because two phrases match.
Seemingly released and being analyzed indicate uncertain publication and passive analysis; needs dedicated support beyond ordinary text messages.
Reverse-role claim is attributed; essayed is the same nonstandard euphemism/possible ASR artifact as 99 and is not an essay-writing vocabulary sense.

Fragment begins Of sexual violence without its subject; 24-7 means continuously, but missing preceding wording cannot be recovered from this PDF. Keep source incomplete and add a reviewed availability expression before closing.
Redirected donations and explicitly stated through her lawyer need supported language items. RAINN is an organization name, not an ordinary vocabulary word; do not invent missing PSA text.
Made it possible to, partnerships, and dedicated researchers remain meaningful barriers; no automatic closure from support alone.
Show notes means episode references and supporting material, not theatrical notes; needs an explicit learning item.
Content warning is a reusable fixed expression; the fragment introduces the next paragraph and needs a card.
News outlet and cutoff time are covered, but court filings versus public records and nested attribution still need explicit language support.
A whole football team of lawyers is deliberate exaggeration of quantity, clarified by 142; needs a reusable quantity/hyperbole note.
Completes 141 with exaggeration; explain rhetorical exaggeration with 138 rather than treating the claims as literal head counts.
Ship something in the mail and means absolutely nothing need explanation; a time phrase alone does not cover the whole claim.
Personified insurer quote and even signal an extreme exception; read with page 11 before deciding whether the risk explanation is adequately supported.

A best dose contractors is suspect ASR for asbestos contractors, but not audio-verified. Sixth worst statistic is explicitly questioned in subsequent paragraphs; do not silently correct or endorse it.
A best dose contract is another suspect ASR form; preserve exact PDF and await audio verification before proposing a quotation repair.
Mold is a specialized comparison in an uncertain asbestos exchange; no confident interpretation from one short sentence.
Sororities needs the female student-organization sense; fraternity alone does not cover it.
Greek life is US fraternity/sorority culture, not life in Greece; needs an explicit learning item.
Resulted in self-insuring is printed wording; possible resorted to is unverified. Speaker also conflates retained risk with setting up insurers, so do not certify the explanation.
Essay in list of grounds for suit is euphemistic/ASR wording, not written composition; retain source and flag. Other insurance claims remain attributed.
Pledged, vague, directed towards, and representative of need support; unfinished disclaimer continues in 195 and must not become an assertion about all organizations.
Completes the not representative disclaimer in 194; review with that full sentence before closing.
Spanked is a concrete action in the initiation account and needs a definition; do not hide it behind a generic hazing label.
Raw onion, forced to plank, and professing undying love contain multiple concrete/idiomatic barriers needing explicit support; no coverage from theme alone.
You're big may be ASR for your big, a fraternity mentor role; do not repair without audio. Continues into 208.
Sarcastic praise after coercive actions; pinnacle remains a vocabulary gap and the opening attaches to uncertain 207.
Dropped means membership removed; court filing needs explicit support and the statement remains a generalized claim, not a verified rule.
BYOB begins option two and is expanded in 216, but wording whole list of BYOB is unclear; read the full checklist before approving.
It has to be marked has an unclear antecedent (list/eligibility); do not invent a specific mark or checking procedure.
Band is likely a wristband used for entry/drinking controls, not musicians; needs an explicit contextual item. Cannot remove is covered by take off.
Ensure in the PDF may stand for insure; retain the original and await audio rather than teaching ensure as insurance protection.
Fellow fraternity brothers and the contrast between checkers' ages and the stated threshold need explanation; no blanket coverage.
Disfluent question about who funds payments; referent of them and insurer/claimant relationships are unclear. Do not convert pays them out into a universal clean model.
Non-brothers means nonmembers, not unrelated siblings; athletic is a further vocabulary gap. Quoted policy account must remain attributed.
Dense attributed account includes rammed in the head, full pledged, and same party on the same plan. Full pledged may be nonstandard/ASR; lack of coverage must not be converted into inability to sue.
Speaker's can't sue them inference is not logically established by the preceding insurance exclusion claim. Explain the modal as the speaker's conclusion, not an actual legal prohibition.
Causative having someone do something plus plastic hoses and explicit anatomy still create barriers. Allegedly is a self-correction limiting the assertion; do not teach this as an instruction.
Bowels/defecated remain concrete vocabulary gaps. May have and indirect evidence indicate inference; the patient's reported lack of memory does not independently establish the narrative.
Fragmented headline-like wording includes ER and alleged injury; bright-eyed is ironic. Do not reconstruct omitted punctuation into a verified quotation or teach the fragment as standard grammar.
Essay is likely a euphemism or ASR rendering of SA in this list. Preserve the PDF, avoid teaching written essay as a lawsuit category, and await audio verification.
Tied with fifth means equal rank, not physically tied. Auto accidents and sample percentage interpretation need explicit support; no general incident prevalence inferred.
Paddling and aesthetic remain gaps; bottom refers to buttocks rather than a financial bottom line. Distinguish physical appearance from emotional effects.
Light side means supposedly less severe end of the spectrum, not illumination or humor; irony and minimization need an explicit note/card.
Paddles are flat implements used for hitting in the account, not rowing activity. On there refers to written organization names; needs concrete vocabulary support.
Spanking is an attempt to clarify the physical action. A one-word concrete vocabulary gap still needs support.
Repeats light side as the allegedly less severe category; keep the unresolved figurative meaning connected to 269.
Full-on is an intensifier meaning outright/complete; side means an aspect. The nouns alone do not teach these everyday-word combinations.
Urinate remains an anatomical vocabulary gap; intoxicated alone is insufficient despite the obvious setting.
Fire escapes and balconies now defined, but bunk bed is another common-word compound needing support. Sequence lists several fall locations rather than one continuous fall.
Defy gravity and keg stand are distinct idiomatic/cultural barriers. Do not supply instructions for the hazardous drinking stunt; explain receptively if added.
Sororities still needs its own lexical support; one in eight is a proportion attributed to some colleges, not a universal housing statistic.
Puddle remains a concrete noun gap. Might sue is a possible legal claim, not a conclusion that the school is liable.
Recounts means tells a past experience; this remains a useful reporting-verb gap rather than automatic coverage from hazing.
Fully fledged versus fully pledged is a spoken correction/play on words; the fixed fully fledged adjective needs explicit teaching beyond pledged alone.
Tossed onto a sheet and flinging up and down remain physical-action barriers; the account is introduced as an allegation.
Tossing him up illustrates prior physical action, but gesture-dependent like this cannot be reconstructed from the PDF.
Essayed is euphemistic/ASR wording in the source, not essay writing; do not silently normalize the quoted allegation without audio.
Slathered, fistfuls, genitals and the locally named mixture mung create barriers beyond waistband; keep explicit account attributed and avoid instructional examples.
Oatmeal and consisted of remain learner targets; source lists contents, but the lesson must not turn it into a recipe for abuse.
Consent to + -ing and smeared still need support; screamed bloody murder is an idiom for loud distress, not literal murder. Explicit absence of consent preserved.
Junk is slang for genitals here, not rubbish, and gallon is a volume measure. Reported response is not promoted as treatment advice.
Made to crawl is passive compulsion; crawl needs a clear physical-action definition. Source has no explicit new subject supplied by us.
Collapsed is a physical-action/medical-state verb needing a contextual definition; do not infer cause or diagnosis from one sentence.
Infamous and inconsistent Kai-Fi versus Chi Phi spelling remain issues. Preserve printed proper name and avoid inventing an official spelling correction in the quotation.
Like the houses is unclear after made posters for parties; preserve possible disfluency/ASR error without inventing the intended clause.
Great Fratsby is a fraternity-themed pun on The Great Gatsby; needs a cultural reference note rather than treating it as a normal adjective+noun phrase.
Piece means an article, not a physical piece; Cornell Sun is the named publication. Published recently is relative to recording time.
Liquor bottles adds the spirits sense of liquor; alcohol alone does not teach the beer-versus-liquor distinction.
Snippets and get into in a second need support; Title IX is a named investigation framework requiring context, not a label for a criminal conviction. Overdose remains an allegation.
Not supposed to means prohibited/against expectations, not inability; fixed expression deserves explicit learner support.
Ragers and keg stands remain cultural/slang gaps; profanity intensifies partying. Imagined sanction distinguishes lost event privileges from eviction.
Touts itself and motto are useful vocabulary gaps; building better men is a quoted slogan contrasted with allegations, not endorsed by the lesson.
Whether...or and hand of brotherhood is extended are rhetorical patterns still needing support; literal hand extension alone misses welcoming assistance metaphor.
Crosses the ages and touch the heart are figurative rhetoric; chivalrous alone does not resolve the whole line.
Lawsuit dropped here likely means released/filed, unlike drop a lawsuit meaning withdraw it. Needs a context-specific explanation before closure.
National coverage phrase now explicit, but Title IX investigation still needs a sourced institutional-framework note; not a synonym for police prosecution.
Abrupt joins Tri Delta October 19th wording may fuse prior enrollment with the incident date. Preserve the transcript but do not assert a verified joining date without audio/context confirmation.
Big and little are mentorship labels in Greek life, not size or age alone; explanation continues with a student peer in 428. Needs explicit role distinction.
Supposed to be expresses expected responsibility; kind of hedges. Fixed supposed to needs explicit support rather than caregiver noun alone.
Subaru differs from prior Uber wording but could be a car make; do not silently repair either. Off campus means outside campus, and venue is named.
Stamp X's on hands is an entry/age marking action; needs support for stamp/marking rather than treating giant literally.
Hawaii themed is a common -themed event construction needing a reusable note; narrator's interesting choice is commentary, not an event-date correction.
Threesome remains an explicit receptive vocabulary gap; proposition is attributed to the lawsuit. Do not infer agreement from a proposal.
Capable of consenting is a central structure needing direct support; reported inability is a pleading claim, not a capacity determination by this review.
Plopped up is suspect or unusual phrasing; retain rather than replace with propped up. Nested attribution Jane says they said separates apparent powder from chemical identification.
Plied someone with needs an explicit vocabulary item; believed to be qualifies rum identification. Source claims remain from pleading, not chemical confirmation.
Engaging in sexual acts and without consent are central structures; a temporal phrase or isolated consent match should not auto-close the sentence.
Elliptical forces oral and forcing intercourse require precise receptive definitions; no graphic expansion or silent repair. Source clearly attributes coercion.
Buttocks, slapping and bruising remain physical-action/injury vocabulary gaps. Multiple times and resulted in distinguish repetition and claimed consequence.
Hops onto a bed is informal movement and leaves this has an unclear object; retain ambiguity rather than inventing what exactly he leaves.
Reach for and euphemistic private parts need support. According to lawsuit scopes the continued attempts; meanwhile marks simultaneous timeline.
Pushing away now supported, but swatting remains a distinct quick striking motion; source describes resistance, not consent.
Grabs someone from someone needs contextual explanation; no rescue motive inferred because later paragraphs explicitly negate it.
Perhaps and rhetorical right introduce narrator's temporary hope; decent/uncovered are additional gaps. Do not label the entrant a rescuer.
So that gives purpose in the attributed act; grabs remains unsupported and the next action is not permission for further contact.
Groping and reaching for private parts are central receptive vocabulary gaps; no euphemistic omission or erotic elaboration supplied.
Continues attributed assault account; initiating another assault and inconsistent Giglio/Jillio spelling remain explicit review issues, not reasons to merge identities silently.
Quoted vulgar sexual wording objectifies a person; requires a receptive register/meaning note and must not become an endorsed everyday speaking example.
Repeats the vulgar phrase to check message content; no new factual confirmation or implication of consent.
Alum is interpreted as room shorthand later, not necessarily an alumnus; quotation needs explicit uncertainty and register treatment.
PU is an abbreviation fragment; do not silently expand it as original message text.
I think marks the narrator's inference that alum names the room. Abbreviated vulgar message still needs a dedicated receptive note, not automatic expansion.

With permission, with consensus, without coercion; allowed without objecting or resisting.

In terms of morals or ethics.

Initialism of point of view.
(art, photography) Dark; characterized by dark tones and muted colors.
Not real; false, fraudulent.

The state of being certain.

Of or relating to preemption.
An assertion, especially an accusation, not necessarily based on facts.
A declaration or remark.
Pertaining to a league or treaty; derived from an agreement or covenant between parties, especially between nations.
Intended or planned; done deliberately or voluntarily.
In a criminal manner.
One that is harmed—killed, injured, subjected to oppression, deceit, or otherwise adversely affected—by someone or something, especially another person or event, force, or condition; in particular:

Arousing strong emotion.

Any injury to the body of a living thing.
The act of pulling back or withdrawing, as from something dangerous, or unpleasant.
In accordance with established forms.
The act of complaining.

plural of prosecutor
Having the equipment, resources, and skills one needs; prepared.
The process where the cells in the body regenerate and repair themselves.
At once; without delay.
